package.name: Otome Hearth
package.description: An otome game in its own Home tab, made from your own characters: love interests who remember what you chose, their texts on your phone, dates and mini-games, and wishes for outfits and memories paid for only with Starlight you earn. An early test build. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Otome Hearth.
